capabilities: Search the vault with natural-language queries from a quick-switcher-style modal
Open results scrolled to the matching section, or in a new tab
Keep the ccc index current automatically on each search
Configure the ccc binary path, result limit, and minimum relevance score
extras: Desktop only; Obsidian mobile cannot run the local ccc program. First search after boot can take up to a minute while ccc loads its model. Privacy notes: plugin makes no network requests, but an API-based embedding provider in ccc would receive queries and note contents. The plugin never installs or updates ccc; the index lives outside the vault.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches keywords only, so notes that never contain the query words can't be found.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a front end for ccc, a separate command-line tool you install yourself.

requires.name: API-based embedding provider (only if ccc is not configured with a local embedding model)

summary: Semantic search modal that finds vault notes by meaning using the local ccc (cocoindex-code) command-line tool.
